bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
root=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
test "$(git -C "$root" rev-parse --show-toplevel)" = "$root" || exit 71
printf 'ROOT_BRANCH='; git -C "$root" branch --show-current
printf 'ROOT_HEAD='; git -C "$root" rev-parse HEAD
printf 'ROOT_TRACKED_DIRTY='; if test -z "$(git -C "$root" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"; then echo NO; else echo YES; fi
git -C "$root" fetch -q origin fix/room-position-3-4-20261111
old=$(mktemp); new=$(mktemp);trap 'rm -f "$old" "$new"' EXIT
git -C "$root" show 450a4d69691a11529f0e3850b8575bf513247ddc:deploy/gserver-compose.yaml > "$old"
git -C "$root" show d2590341c0745396b17e6a83764f84922cd90e01:deploy/gserver-compose.yaml > "$new"
printf 'ROOT_COMPOSE_EQUALS_450='; if cmp -s "$old" "$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml"; then echo YES; else echo NO; fi
printf 'COMPOSE_PATCH_ONLY_FLAG='; if diff -u "$old" "$new" | grep -q '^+      GAYBBS_NOTIFICATION_DELIVERY_ENABLED: enabled$'; then echo YES; else echo NO; fi
printf 'LIVE_NOTIFICATION_ENV='; if docker inspect --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' deploy-gaybbs-1 | grep -q '^GAYBBS_NOTIFICATION_DELIVERY_ENABLED=enabled$'; then echo ENABLED; else echo DISABLED; fi
